moxfieldAccess: The pinned index supplies queue links. These are verified Wizards / MTGJSON lists, not direct Moxfield exports.
normalization: Flip and Adventure cards retain their front names; split cards retain their combined names. Full Scryfall faces are preserved in oracle.json.
